Medical eye care in Clear Lake

Medical eye care in Clear Lake, from a doctor who manages the condition - not just checks the box

Medical eye care in Clear Lake is not something you settle in a rushed 15-minute visit. Dry eye, glaucoma, diabetic eyes, macular degeneration, cataracts, and LASIK aftercare are all handled here under one roof - diagnosed, managed, and followed over time rather than looked at once and forgotten. Dr. Jerry Hyder, OD, takes the time to work out what is actually going on with your eyes and what to do about it.

Book an Eye Exam Call (281) 488-0066

Find the right care for your concern

The eye conditions we manage, all in one place

Every condition below is one Dr. Hyder manages here himself. Find the one that fits what you are dealing with, and it will take you to a page that explains the care in full.

Dry Eye Treatment Real relief for burning, gritty, or watery eyes - starting with a diagnosis of the cause rather than another bottle of drugstore drops. Learn more
Glaucoma Testing & Management Early detection, plus ongoing pressure and nerve monitoring to protect your sight over time. Learn more
Diabetic Eye Exams A yearly dilated screening for diabetic retinopathy - often billable to your medical plan. Learn more
Macular Degeneration Care Diagnosis and regular monitoring to protect your central vision. Learn more
Cataract Co-Management Dr. Hyder handles your evaluation and your pre- and post-op care and coordinates the surgery with a trusted specialist. The procedure itself is done by that surgeon - it is not performed here. Learn more
LASIK Co-Management The consultation plus your pre- and post-op care, with a referral to a trusted surgeon for the procedure itself. We handle the care around it, not the surgery. Learn more
Red / Sore Eye A sudden red or sore eye, looked at quickly rather than left to get worse. Learn more
Pink Eye / Conjunctivitis A red, weepy, or irritated eye seen quickly, so it does not linger or spread. Learn more
Flashes & Floaters New flashes or floaters checked promptly to rule out a retinal problem. Learn more
Foreign Body Removal Something caught in your eye, removed safely and gently by the doctor. Learn more

Why this kind of care is different

An eye disease is managed over years, not checked in a single visit

Glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, and macular degeneration are rarely a one-visit event. They are watched and managed over years, and the person most likely to catch the change that matters is the doctor who remembers last year's pressures and last year's photos - because that is what a slow change is measured against.

So the work is in the years that follow. Dr. Hyder is a licensed therapeutic optometrist, and managing a condition here means ongoing pressure and nerve monitoring for glaucoma, a yearly dilated screening for diabetic eyes, and the pre- and post-op care around cataract surgery and LASIK. Treatment is adjusted as your eyes change, and that clear, focused read on what they need is what protects your sight.

Why trust us with a lasting condition

42 years caring for the same Clear Lake families

A condition you live with for years is easier to manage when the doctor already knows your eyes. Dr. Hyder has cared for Clear Lake families since 1984 - 42 years in the same community, with patients who have stayed with him for decades. That is the whole point of continuity: one doctor who saw you last year, and the year before, is the one most likely to notice a slow change that a stranger would miss because they never had a baseline to compare it to. The proof here is not a success rate on a chart - it is the relationship and the record of showing up, year after year.
